subtitles.en: I am curious if you can go back to your early investment in Anthropic and what you saw obviously at the time a company Effectively without a product a company with a lot of promise right and we were heard from the CFO earlier today about

en_highlights: What did you see back then

subtitles.en: I'm in special team Daria is one of the most smartest kind of capable thoughtful people you'll meet a great kind of Cultural mindset around trust and safety that was kind of a foundational tenant of the company as you know at the time
subtitles.zh: 我在特别团队，Daria是你能遇到的最聪明、最有能力、最深思熟虑的人之一，围绕信任和安全有一种伟大的文化心态，正如你所知，这是公司当时的基础原则

subtitles.en: That you mentioned it was pre-revenue pre-product and yet they were benchmarking the models against open AI Which was kind of leading the frontier at the time and they were at or better than them on almost every dimension

subtitles.en: And they'd raised like one one hundredth the capital So you kind of look at capital efficiency great team trust and safety And you know as soon as they launched the model into the wild the revenue just started to soar

subtitles.en: But it's a big day because for Menlo, it's the first time You're investing in an IPO. Yeah, I know you as an early stage guy
subtitles.zh: 但今天是个大日子，因为对Menlo Ventures来说，这是你们第一次参与IPO。是的，我知道你是早期阶段的市场参与者

subtitles.en: How much of the allocation did you get? We got about 50% of our allocation But what did you ask for? Well just a good a good number nothing nothing outrageous
subtitles.zh: 你们获得了多少分配？我们获得了约50%的分配。但你们要求了多少？嗯，只是一个不错的数字，没什么离谱的

subtitles.en: It's not really our business to invest in IPOs. You're right. We're early and growth stage investor But like we just felt this was such an exceptional opportunity
subtitles.zh: 参与IPO并不是我们的主要业务。你说得对，我们是早期和成长阶段的市场参与者，但我们觉得这是一个非常特殊的机会

subtitles.en: We really believe in the long-term Fundamentals the S1 speaks for itself the size of this market where we are early innings of growth So we we wanted to expand the position not looking to
subtitles.zh: 我们真的相信长期基本面，S1文件本身就能说明问题，这个市场的规模，我们正处于增长的早期阶段，所以我们想扩大仓位，不打算

subtitles.en: To sell and thinking more about the future than than where it is right now
subtitles.zh: 卖出，更多考虑未来而不是现在的位置

具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
